> LGTM about this PR, but shouldn't "Edit in notepad" be available for CMD files and AHK files?

We can support those as well, it's essentially the same as the shell extension but easier to access.

Two more things I noticed
~1. This action needs to be disabled in Recycle Bin~
2. This action needs to be updated to support multiple files

In theory this should work now but in practice it's not...

issue_context.title: Feature: Display "Edit" menu item for Batch Files in the main context menu
issue_context.body:
### What feature or improvement do you think would benefit Files?

The shell extension "Edit" is currently hidden away in the sub menu when right clicking batch files. We can improve the user experience by displaying this option in the main menu.

### Requirements

- Display "Edit" menu item in the main when right clicking batch files
- Position the menu item after "open"

### Files Version

v3.4.1

### Windows Version

Windows 11

### Comments

_No response_

review_comments: There are probably other actions that need to be disabled in Recycle Bin.
We should check it, but it's a separate issue.
